title: Sneaking out of the hotel and riding home to Dallas
summary: Unable to pay, the boys lower their bags down a chute, escape at 3 a.m. in Lightnin's Packard, and Budd notes Keg stayed with him until Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: ever else little money we had we would try to save it up so we could try to pay some rent.

Well anyway, summer was running out on us, and we haven't made enough money to pay the rent, so now we're planning on how to get back home. So we met a guy, they call him Lightnin', and he had a Packard sedan, Packard automobile, and we propositioned him, and he said yeah, he would drive us back to Dallas for $75.00.

Well we only had saved up about $25.00, so we wrote to our parents, you know, and they said they would give him the rest of the money when he came, so okay. Now we had to get out of this hotel. So we all had inside rooms, and there was a big chute that went all the way down to the floor, so we would stick our heads out, the cat on the top floor would drop his bag down. We'd catch it, and then the cat on the next floor, we'd drop it to him and he'd catch it, until we got all the --
This was like about 3:00 o'clock in the morning, and until we got all of the bags out and we snuck out of the hotel, got in the car, and we're gone.
Now I have been back to Tulsa many times, but that man never asked me for the money. You know? And he never asked anybody for the money, but however, we went on back to Dallas.
Okay, so I'm playing around Dallas, and we are all getting quite good, you know. We're getting quite good.
Keg is with me all the way.
We never did separate until we came to Kansas City, and I can tell you about that story later.
Sure, a little later on, or ahead, oh.
